description: Defines data structures and helper methods for parsing host and port information from network address strings, and constructing URL strings with optional host and port parameters.

classes.name: SettingsHostPort
classes.description: A data structure representing a network host and port pair.

methods.name: parseHostPort(from:)
methods.description: Parses a string representing a network address to extract host and port components, returning a SettingsHostPort instance if successful.

methods.name: httpURLString(host:port:fallback:)
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP URL string using given host and port, or falls back to a default URL if parameters are missing.
